routes.approach: Import WattsFoundation.GeneratorRegularActions and Proofs.EilenbergWatts in the article workspace. The module chain supplies both SmallGeneratorBridge.equivalenceOfSmallProjectiveGenerator and the new regular-module lemmas. Install Projective P and Projective Q from the reviewed premises and apply the bridge to their separator and discrete-colimit-preservation inputs. Use HP.asEquivalence and HQ.asEquivalence. Precompose with the source inverse and postcompose with HQ, then lift both directions and the unit and counit to Good using the finite and discrete colimit and additivity fields. Instantiate EilenbergWatts with ring universe v and lift universe 0. Use its inverse on the whiskered functor and its equality with regular evaluation. The checked regularToHom_right gives the pointwise action identity. Check the remaining categorical square in a separate lemma with symbolic P and p. For the exact conjugated right multiplication rho at op p from EilenbergWatts, prove rho ≫ (regularToHom P).hom = (regularToHom P).hom ≫ HP.map (End.asHom p). Use ModuleCat.hom_ext, extensionality on ULift.up r, and the definition of rho to reduce to regularToHom_right. Transport the square through the source inverse and the unit at P. The resulting regular evaluation isomorphism intertwines its right action with F.obj.map (End.asHom p). Define the direct bimodule functor with object carrier HQ.obj (F.obj P) and map HQ.map (θ.app P), using precomposition by q for the left action and postcomposition by F.obj.map (End.asHom p) for the right action. Use the transported regular comparison to prove naturality and right linearity of the isomorphism to the direct functor, then apply changeFunctor. Prove the strict equality to eval from the direct object and map definitions. Use that equality to calculate (q ≫ b) ≫ F.obj.map (End.asHom p) and b ≫ θ.app P through the reviewed casts. These are the remaining checks for the article endpoint. The current plan still schedules ProjectiveGeneratorModuleReconstruction.
